originality.rationale: The strict parity sign and signed factorial asymptotic do not appear in the inspected primary derangement moments and conditioned-process texts, while the exact covariance identity itself is a direct known-moment deduction and not claimed as novel. Four targeted published-finding corpus searches produced no equivalent claim. Residual risk: a historic equivalent sign inequality hidden in broader combinatorial literature.
residual_risks: Earlier literature may contain the alternating-exponential partial-sum determinant inequality under inclusion-exclusion or derangement number inequalities, which would cover the sign conclusion despite different terminology.
Da Silva–Jamshidpey–Tavaré (2020) already give sufficiently general exact moments to derive the covariance expression, which is explicitly excluded from originality claims.
Only the uniform derangement law is addressed; no claim of extension to other Ewens parameters.
